statusDetail: Cloudflare returned a 403 “Sorry, you have been blocked” page to Chrome and the raw fetch, so the target site UI, routes, flows, and authored behavior could not be inspected.

page.notes: The origin was not observable because Cloudflare served its access-block template.

artifacts.caption: Entry URL rendered as a Cloudflare access-block page.
Rendered DOM shows Cloudflare “Sorry, you have been blocked”, not the target site.
Recon probe records Cloudflare title, no target navigation, and noindex/nofollow.
Headers observed on the Cloudflare 403 response; not treated as target-site security evidence.
Raw fetch received HTTP 403 and both browser/crawler views show the block page.
Rendered browser view of the Cloudflare block page.
No-JavaScript crawler view of the same Cloudflare block page.
Atomic manifest and initial evidence plan for all 58 catalog checks.
Pinned Modern Web Guidance catalog consulted before inspection.
Guidance search related to blocking, resilience, recovery, and security.
Retrieved pinned security and privacy guidance.
